title: Produce radio component audit sheet
description: Audit the radio filter as an individual single-choice component with explicit selection, reset, accessibility, and styling contracts.
objective: Define how radio behaves and looks as a single-choice filter without collapsing it into checkbox or chip behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Radio input, option label, group label, selected state, reset relationship, focus, hover, disabled, and layout modes are treated as separate subelements.
Single-choice semantics and deselect/reset behavior are explicit.
Radio is distinguished from checkbox and chips.
The audit does not implement radio fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: radio render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Radio can become a fake segmented control without preserving single-choice semantics.
Reset behavior can stay ambiguous if it is not audited separately.
